Passion Rénovation est une chaîne YouTub: Passion Rénovation is a YouTube channel with over 370,000 subscribers, devoted to home renovation work. Its creator shares his projects transparently, with humour and a teaching style that has won over a large community.
La chaîne YouTube de Mickael, qui docume: Mickael's YouTube channel, which has been documenting the complete renovation of his house for years. An ambitious personal project told with sincerity and method, inspiring tens of thousands of DIYers to roll up their sleeves. After a few years on a plateau (380K subscribers), the channel has regained momentum with a flagship project each year. Our verdict: "An excellent example of what YouTube can offer when you tell a personal project authentically. It's positive, concrete and motivating." — Lolo.
